item1.headline: teach theory, not reality.
item1.body: They teach you to click buttons, not think like an engineer. It's not your fault — the QA learning system is broken at its core.

item2.headline: fail a screen after "completing a course".
item2.body: A certificate won't replace instinct. Recruiters see it in 5 minutes. Your CV says one thing — the interview says another.

item3.headline: before you understand how frontend works.
item3.body: Nobody told you this earlier. They should have. We tell you straight — and cut that time down to weeks.
